snippet.title: Song of Morus: Limbo Express - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
"Song of Morus: Limbo Express" is a motion-packed non-linear third-person shooter set on a ghost train racing through the underworld. You have to spider-walk across the curved surface of a flying train as it twists like a rollercoaster through limbo. And you have to shoot enemies, and you have to dodge their bullets, and you have to avoid deadly obstacles on the tracks.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3751160/Song_of_Morus_Limbo_Express/

Developer: Night Chill Studio
X: https://x.com/SunnyChowTheGuy
